name: When is the best time of year to start a backyard renovation project in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a backyard renovation project in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: While backyard renovations can occur year-round in Southern California, starting the design phase in late fall or early winter allows ample time for planning, permitting, and material selection before the peak construction season. This can position your project for groundbreaking in early spring, leading to completion during the milder weather of late spring or early summer, allowing you to enjoy your new space throughout the best seasons. Avoiding the rainy season (typically December-March) for major excavation work can also prevent delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Starting design in late fall or early winter is ideal, aiming for construction to begin in early spring to complete before the hottest months and avoid winter rains.
